"""Hard instances: small capacities, tight budgets -> large dual magnitudes."""
import json, random

def gen_request(rng):
    n = rng.randint(2, 10)
    m = rng.randint(2, 24)
    edges = []
    for _ in range(m):
        t=rng.randrange(n); h=rng.randrange(n)
        while h==t: h=rng.randrange(n)
        edges.append([t,h,rng.randint(1,12)])
    heads=[e[1] for e in edges]
    adj={}
    for i,e in enumerate(edges): adj.setdefault(e[0],[]).append(i)
    commodities=[]; total=0
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,8)):
        s=rng.randrange(n); tg=rng.randrange(n)
        while tg==s: tg=rng.randrange(n)
        paths=[]
        for _ in range(rng.randint(1,4)):
            node=s; cur=[]; visited={s}; ok=True
            for _ in range(rng.randint(1,6)):
                nxt=adj.get(node)
                if not nxt: ok=False; break
                eid=rng.choice(nxt); cur.append(eid); node=heads[eid]
                if node in visited: ok=False; break
                visited.add(node)
                if node==tg: break
            if ok and cur and node==tg: paths.append(cur)
        paths=list({tuple(p):p for p in paths}.values())
        rng.shuffle(paths); paths=paths[:16]
        total+=len(paths)
        demand=rng.randint(0,25)
        if paths:
            w=[0]*len(paths); left=16
            for i in range(len(paths)-1):
                w[i]=rng.randint(0,left); left-=w[i]
            w[-1]=left
        else: w=[]
        commodities.append({"source":s,"target":tg,"demand":demand,"paths":paths,"previous":w})
    failed=[]
    if rng.random()<0.3 and m: failed=rng.sample(range(m),min(m,2))
    budget=rng.choice([0,0,1,2,5,20,100,1000])
    return {"epoch":rng.randint(0,2147483647),"node_count":n,
            "edges":[{"tail":t,"head":h,"capacity":c} for (t,h,c) in edges],
            "commodities":commodities,"failed_edges":failed,"budget":budget}
PYEOF

import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
import genhard, check
import numpy as np
seed=int(sys.argv[1]); count=int(sys.argv[2])
rng=random.Random(seed)
reqs=[genhard.gen_request(rng) for _ in range(count)]
data=("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n").encode()
t0=time.time()
proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=1200)
print("planner %.2fs"%(time.time()-t0))
lines=proc.stdout.decode().splitlines()
bad=0; worst=0.0; worst_y=0.0; worst_gap=0.0
for req,line in zip(reqs,lines):
    resp=json.loads(line); d=check.build(req)
    errs=check.check(req,resp)
    if errs: bad+=1; print("FAIL",errs); print(json.dumps(req)[:300]); print(line[:300])
    if resp["status"]=="optimal":
        y=np.array(resp["dual"]["inequality"]); q=np.array(resp["dual"]["equality"])
        acc=d["A_ub"].T.dot(y)+(d["A_eq"].T.dot(q) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        v=float((acc-d["c"]).max()); worst=max(worst,v)
        L=float(d["b_ub"].dot(y))+(float(d["b_eq"].dot(q)) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        worst_gap=max(worst_gap,abs(resp["mlu"]-L)); worst_y=max(worst_y,np.abs(y).max())
    else:
        y=np.array(resp["certificate"]["inequality"]); q=np.array(resp["certificate"]["equality"])
        acc=d["A_ub"].T.dot(y)+(d["A_eq"].T.dot(q) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        v=float(acc.max()); worst=max(worst,v); worst_y=max(worst_y,np.abs(y).max())
        val=float(d["b_ub"].dot(y))+(float(d["b_eq"].dot(q)) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        worst_gap=max(worst_gap,abs(val-1.0))
print("bad=%d worst_viol=%.3g worst_|y|=%.4g worst_gap=%.3g"%(bad,worst,worst_y,worst_gap))
if proc.stderr: print(proc.stderr.decode()[-800:])
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PYEOF
